correctness.rationale: For each coefficient gamma_i(a,b) of the diagonal-e_i tensor, the e_ij bimodule identity equates zero-padded values along every comparability edge, forcing either zero or a unique componentwide least/greatest pair. This exhausts all maps. Explicit coproduct images prove coassociativity, rank, injectivity and counitality. In the diamond the two paths to the top are identified by a single nonmonomial binomial and the coproduct is injective. The original linear equations were independently reconstructed in 814 finite-field/poset cases.
